topic.title: Creating Review Tasks
topic.shortdesc: Review tasks let Subject-Matter Experts create, manage, and review shared content.

body.p: This topic explains how Subject-Matter Experts can create and manage their own review tasks.
When you create a review task, you can share content with other people, invite reviewers, and follow the discussion in one place.

section.title: When to create your own review task

ul.li: When you need feedback on a set of files.
When you want to start and manage the review yourself.
When you want to share content and collect comments in one place.
When you want to track discussions and review progress.

section.title: What Subject-Matter Experts do in these tasks
section.p: Subject-Matter Experts can create review tasks, manage them as task owners, or participate in shared tasks as reviewers. In both cases, they can read content, add comments, suggest changes, and reply to discussions.

section.title: What task owners can do
section.p: As a task owner, you can share the task, manage access, assign roles, and control the review task status.
